rawContent: Then it started getting bigger, and they couldn’t ignore it. The headlines started popping up, “Evangelicalism’s #MeToo Moment” and “#MeToo comes to church” etc. but they didn’t want to say #ChurchToo. They actively avoided it. And we all knew why.

My abuser posted a supportive status about the #metoo movement on his Facebook in the days leading up the launch of #churchtoo and I think about that all the time. These people really think they will never get caught.
